decisions.because: Counterexample (hunt round 2, 2026-10-10): with reasons B (60 s) and A (600 s) at one instant, retracting A answered 'shortened' but unblocked the target at once: the reissued shorter claim collided with B's retracted claim id and was born retracted. No contract stated the shortening boundary (ADR-0019), so it becomes one.

statement: Retracting a detector reason that held a target longer than its other reasons shortens the block to the latest remaining end: the target stays blocked until then and is released after. A reported shortening is never a lift.
